title: AI interface and ability to speak to support
summary: Feedback on talking to support and the AI interface is split between a willing follow-up comment, criticism of the AI interface, and an unclear but unfavorable account of poor customer contact and dealer-leaning support.

positive.summary: One positive review expresses willingness to continue the conversation further.

negative.summary: One negative review criticizes the AI interface as very poor.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review describes poor customer support, unanswered phone contact, and perceived bias toward the dealership, but the overall sentiment assignment remains undetermined.

limitations: The topic is based on only a few short fragments, so the examples are insufficient to establish a broader pattern.
One fragment is undetermined despite containing unfavorable language, which limits confidence in interpreting overall sentiment.
The sampled comments cover related but not identical subjects, including AI interface quality and human customer support contact.
